text:
grant: quick flag from nova11b-int3 canary on staging 9— latency/cost are great but we see regression in code-generation correctness for multi-file examples and some RAG-merge failures when context >3k tokens. want to assemble a focused mini-golden and do a short relabel + dedupe before any wider rollout.
mei: rough numbers?
grant: ran 400 multi-turn canary sessions (mix of code+RAG). summary: 
```
metric                    fp16    int3    delta
----------------------------------------------
code_correct@top1         0.782   0.726   -0.056
rag_merge_f1              0.698   0.663   -0.035
avg_latency(ms)           310     210    -100
cost/tok                  1.00    0.44   -56%
```
grant: main worry is incorrect code edits and missed cross-doc citations in RAG. not huge but visible on customer repros.
aleks: this is curation + labeling work. propose: 1) build mini-golden of 220 items (140 code-focused multi-file edits, 80 RAG merge multi-doc prompts) 2) run shingle-hash + embed-sim dedupe (threshold 0.88) 3) send for 3-way consensus with a tiny QA pass for code execution where feasible.
mei: agree. add an explicit set of 30 randomized flaky examples that exercise code-context windowing and module imports. include synthetic examples that force cross-file symbol resolution.
grant: will tag those as FASTLANE_30. also add a small instrument to the harness to capture span-level diffs (where code lines are removed/duplicated).
labeler-bot: created task ML-GOLD-177777 for "nova11b-int3 code+RAG mini-golden relabel". 220 items assigned (fastlane 30 flagged). ETA 48h. :robot_face:
infra: FYI 99 staging has a new prefix-cache patch; if you want to compare with old behavior run canary with `--cache=legacy` flag. if you need >3x parallel evals request 2h ahead.
aleks: dedupe plan: run tools/shingle_dedupe_v1.py --min-shingle 5 --sim-thresh 0.88 --align-spans then fallback to fuzzyhash for non-text artifacts. collisions get manual triage.
mei: labeling instructions: primary check = functional correctness for code (does the suggested edit compile/run on the unit test snippet?) secondary = semantic citation accuracy for RAG. tag samples with HALLU_CODE or RAG_MERGE_FAIL. include small snippet output or failing line numbers if applicable. link rubric: https://confluence.redwood.ai/curation/code-rag-golden-rubric
grant: kicking off dedupe now, will post collision counts.
labeler-bot: dedupe started (job 177777-dedupe). estimated collisions ~20%.
mei: note for labelers 999 when assessing code edits, prefer the execution result if deterministically checkable; otherwise prioritize minimal semantic regressions. anything that removes or invents an import should be HALLU_CODE.
aleks: after relabel, run `eval/harness/compare_models.py --models nova11b-fp16,nova11b-int3 --subset mini-golden --report span-diffs,exec-failures` and post the delta table.
labeler-bot: relabel complete. 220 -> consensus 201 items (19 abstains). fastlane 30 -> consensus 28 (2 abstains). results uploaded: s3://redwood-qa/nova11b-int3-mini/177777/results.json
grant: first eval on consensus set: 
```
metric                    fp16    int3    delta
----------------------------------------------
code_correct@top1         0.779   0.749   -0.030
rag_merge_f1              0.695   0.682   -0.013
exec_fail_rate            0.042   0.048   +0.006
avg_latency(ms)           310     210    -100
```
grant: better after relabel but still a 3% code gap on the code-focused subset. fast-lane scaffold attempt: try prompt scaffold that asks "preserve original imports and only modify body" on the 30 fast-lane.
mei: we can do that quickly. labelers can QA the 30 in ~5h.
labeler-bot: created ML-GOLD-177777-fastlane for scaffold checks. 10 labelers assigned; ETA 5h.
grant: scaffold applied + re-eval on 28 consensus fast-lane: code_correct@top1 delta now -0.008 vs fp16. exec_fail_rate unchanged.
tasha: metrics look acceptable for a limited dedicated canary if we gate tightly. set rollout gate: hold if code_correct drop >1.5% overall or exec_fail_rate > 0.06 or rag_merge_f1 drop >1%.
mei: also add alert for span-diff rate > 2% where lines are removed.
aleks: I'll attach dedupe artifacts and the shingle traces to the golden registry entry `nova11b-int3-code-rag-mini-20250130`.
grant: filing rollout ticket RW-177777 with owners: grant (owner), mei (metrics), aleks (curation), tasha (ops). will schedule a 72h canary with tight dashboards for exec_fail, code_correct, rag_merge_f1, span_diff. thanks all :party_popper:
